description: Import memory from a GitHub Gist. Merges entries (keeps newer dates, combines tags). Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

gist_id.description: GitHub Gist ID or full URL (https://gist.github.com/user/id).

merge.description: If true, merge with existing memory. If false, replace entirely.

name: memory_import_gist
title: Import from GitHub Gist
